hypothesis: The two-deep FP16 input pipeline currently places the second residual slot at the same 64-byte phase as the first and as the corresponding x slot. Advancing only the second residual slot by 32 bytes may change bank contention while MTE2 loads the next residual tile and Vector consumes the current pair. This is an unmeasured placement hypothesis; no bank width is asserted.
